title: Cloud Systems Engineer/DevOps
description:
About the Product

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.

Role Overview

We are seeking an expert-level, highly skilled Cloud Systems Engineer (DevOps) to serve as a GCP Specialist and technical builder for our Google Cloud ecosystem. This role requires more than administration; you must be capable of building architectural change, adjusting systems, and driving modernization efforts. You will be responsible for the end-to-end management of our GCP infrastructure, from complex networking to proactive cost optimization and resource scaling. A key responsibility is leading and running large-scale cloud migration projects, specifically from AWS to GCP.

The ideal candidate ensures our Compute Engine environment is lean, fast, and resilient while maintaining secure connectivity using both native and third-party VPN solutions.

The role’s primary focus demands deep GCP expertise, but candidates must also possess significant experience with AWS for successful migration

strategy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Infrastructure & Networking: Configure and maintain robust networking architectures, including Cloud DNS and Cloud NAT.
  • Linux System Administration: Manage and maintain the operating system environment on Compute Engine instances, including patching, configuration management, user account management, and troubleshooting core system issues.
  • VPN Management: Build and manage secure tunnels using Cloud VPN , pfSense virtual appliances, and CloudConnexa (OpenVPN) for flexible remote access.
  • Performance Monitoring: Utilize Google Cloud Operations Suite to monitor Compute Engine health. Identify bottlenecks and tune instances for peak performance.
  • Resource Management: Oversee persistent disks, snapshots, and storage buckets. Ensure high availability while purging unused resources to maintain environment hygiene.
  • Cost Optimization: Actively monitor billing dashboards, implement committed use discounts (CUDs), and right-size underutilized instances to maintain a lean budget.
  • Database Oversight: Provide support for PostgreSQL and Oracle environments, ensuring seamless integration and performance within the GCP ecosystem.
  • Security & Compliance : Enforce IAM roles and security best practices to protect the project perimeter

Required Qualifications

  • Certification: Active Google Cloud Professional DevOps Engineer certification.
  • Containerization Mastery: Strong expertise with Docker for containerizing applications, managing images, and troubleshooting container runtimes.
  • Scripting Mastery: High proficiency in Python or Bash for automating routine infrastructure tasks, reporting, and task scheduling.
  • Networking Expertise: Hands-on experience managing network routing, firewall rules, and site-to-site VPNs using pfSense and CloudConnexa.
  • Cloud Migration & Project Leadership: Proven experience leading and running application and data migrations from AWS to GCP. This includes the capability to own the end-to-end migration project life cycle and drive solutions.
  • Compute Engine Mastery: Deep understanding of VM lifecycles, custom machine types, and auto-scaling.
  • English Proficiency: Advanced English level (B2–C1 or higher)

Nice-to-Have

  • PostgreSQL Expertise: Strong hands-on experience with configuration, optimization, and query tuning.
  • Oracle Expertise: Experience managing or migrating Oracle database environments.
  • Data & Analytics: Familiarity with BigQuery.

We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule).
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.

As this is an English-speaking role, we kindly ask that all applications be submitted with a CV in English.

title: Quality Assurence
description:
Estamos buscando profissionais de QA com forte atuação funcional e suporte técnico em automação.

Buscamos profissionais para atuação em qualidade ponta a ponta , com foco em validação funcional, geração de evidências e rastreabilidade das entregas em um ecossistema com microserviços, integrações e múltiplos meios de pagamento .

Essa posição tem foco funcional, porém exige conhecimento obrigatório em JavaScript e Playwright , para apoiar validações técnicas, ajustes de fluxo e interpretações de respostas de APIs quando necessário.

Você fará parte de um time orientado à excelência em qualidade, atuando de forma próxima aos times de desenvolvimento, produto e operações.

Responsabilidades

  • Participar de refinamentos, entendimento de regras de negócio e definição de critérios de aceite.
  • Planejar, executar e evidenciar testes funcionais ponta a ponta.
  • Criar e manter cenários e casos de teste com rastreabilidade no Jira/Xray , utilizando BDD com Gherkin (uso obrigatório) .
  • Executar testes de regressão, testes exploratórios e suporte a UAT/homologação.
  • Validar integrações e fluxos críticos envolvendo APIs, microserviços, mensageria (SQS), ERP e meios de pagamento (Pix, Boleto e Cartão) .
  • Acompanhar incidentes/bugs, apoiar priorização e realizar retestes.
  • Garantir rastreabilidade entre requisito ↔ teste ↔ evidência ↔ defeito .
  • Implementar testes e ajustes utilizando Playwright .
  • Apoiar validações técnicas com JavaScript (ex.: lógica de validação, estruturação de payloads, análise de respostas de APIs, interpretação de objetos JSON e pequenos scripts de apoio).

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência com testes funcionais e processos de qualidade em ambientes ágeis.
  • Vivência com sistemas distribuídos e integrações (APIs/microserviços).
  • Experiência com validação de APIs via Postman ou Insomnia .
  • Experiência com Jira e Xray .
  • Uso obrigatório de BDD com Gherkin para criação e manutenção de cenários.
  • Boa escrita de cenários, critérios de aceite e documentação de evidências.
  • Experiência com testes de regressão e priorização de cenários críticos.
  • Conhecimento obrigatório em JavaScript (não atuará como QE, mas precisa interpretar, ajustar e criar pequenos trechos de código).
  • Experiência sólida com Playwright (locators, interações, assertions, waits, screenshots e vídeos).
  • Experiência com CI/CD e execução de testes em pipelines (ex.: Jenkins) .
  • Conhecimento em Docker e ambientes conteinerizados.

Diferenciais

  • Noções de observabilidade (Dynatrace, Loki).
  • Experiência com jornadas de Checkout e Pagamentos (Pix, boleto, cartão) .
  • Noções de segurança/controles (ex.: PCI) aplicados a testes.
  • Conhecimento básico em AWS ou ambientes cloud (multi-account) .

Sobre a OSF Digital

A OSF Digital tem orgulho de ser uma empresa que oferece oportunidades iguais, onde você pode ser você mesmo no trabalho. Junte-se a uma comunidade inclusiva e apaixonada de profissionais que ajudam a promover a transformação digital para empresas ao redor do mundo.

Na OSF Digital, acolhemos todas as pessoas e não discriminamos com base em identidade e expressão de gênero, raça, etnia, deficiência, orientação sexual, cor, religião, origem nacional, idade, estado civil ou qualquer outra categoria protegida em qualquer jurisdição onde atuamos.

title: AI Evaluation Engineer
description:
About FirstIgnite

FirstIgnite is the AI-powered business development platform for university technology transfer offices (TTOs). We help research institutions turn breakthroughs into partnerships, licenses, and companies by combining deep LLM-driven workflows with the relationships that actually move deals forward. Our product suite spans expert discovery, grants search, and AI-driven outreach — all built on a modern, agentic stack.

We ship fast, we measure everything, and we believe evaluations are the difference between AI features that demo well and AI features that work in production.

The Role

We're hiring an AI Evaluation Engineer to own the quality bar for every LLM-powered feature we ship. You'll design, build, and scale the infrastructure that tells us — with evidence — whether a prompt change, model swap, or agent refactor made things better or worse.

This is a high-leverage role. Every customer-facing AI capability at FirstIgnite flows through your evals. You'll work directly with the Head of Engineering and partner closely with product, applied AI, and the full-stack team to establish evaluation as a first-class discipline across the company.

What You'll Do

  • Build evaluation infrastructure: Design and maintain eval suites using Promptfoo, LLM-as-judge methodologies, and custom harnesses for features like our expert search system, natural language grants search, and AI SDR agents.
  • Define what 'good' means: Partner with product and domain experts to translate fuzzy customer outcomes ("does this surface the right principal investigator?") into precise, measurable rubrics.
  • Own the feedback loop: Instrument production traffic, curate golden datasets from real customer interactions, and build pipelines that turn user behavior into regression tests.
  • Ship quickly under uncertainty: We routinely run 48-hour eval sprints for greenfield features with no production traffic. You'll be comfortable bootstrapping quality signal from scratch.
  • Model and prompt evaluation: Run rigorous A/B comparisons across models (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-weight), prompt strategies, and agent architectures. Quantify tradeoffs between cost, latency, and quality.
  • Agent evaluation: Help us measure multi-step agent behavior built on the OpenAI Agents SDK, Vercel AI SDK, and Temporal Cloud — including tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, and end-to-end task completion.
  • Raise the floor for the team: Create templates, documentation, and tooling so every engineer can write and run evals as part of normal development. Evals should feel as natural as unit tests.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of engineering experience, with at least 1 year focused on LLM/ML evaluation, applied AI, or data quality systems.
  • Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation frameworks — Promptfoo, Braintrust, LangSmith, OpenAI Evals, DeepEval, or equivalent in-house tooling.
  • Strong grasp of LLM-as-judge methodology, including its failure modes (position bias, verbosity bias, judge-model drift) and how to mitigate them.
  • Statistical literacy — you know the difference between a real regression and noise, and you can design experiments that answer the question actually being asked.
  • Product instincts. You can sit with a customer success call transcript, identify the three failure modes that matter, and ship an eval for each by end of week.
  • Strong written communication. Evals are useless if the engineers shipping features don't trust or read the results.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience evaluating retrieval systems (RAG, hybrid search, reranking) — especially over structured or semi-structured domains like research, grants, or patents.
  • Exposure to agent orchestration frameworks (Temporal, LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK) and the specific challenges of evaluating multi-step, tool-using systems.
  • Background in information retrieval, search relevance, or a research-adjacent domain.
  • Experience building internal tooling or dashboards that non-engineers (PMs, domain experts) actually use to label and review model outputs.

Why This Role

  • You'll be the first dedicated evals hire. The scope, standards, and tooling are yours to define.
  • AI quality is existential for our product. This isn't a compliance role tucked into a corner — it's directly on the critical path to revenue.
  • Small, senior team. ~10 engineers, distributed globally, with a strong bias toward shipping and measuring.
  • Direct access to real-world, high-stakes LLM use cases — research discovery, grants, outbound — across a customer base that deeply values accuracy.

This is a fully remote position. We have engineers across the Americas, Europe, and Africa. Overlap with US working hours is expected.

You’ll work directly with Marketing, with guidance from the Creative Director. Most of what you produce will show up in demand gen campaigns, event programs, and product marketing. It needs to look sharp, ship fast, and hold up across channels.

What you’ll do

  • You’ll be responsible for a wide range of design work tied directly to pipeline-driving campaigns
  • Create graphics for social, paid campaigns, email, and web
  • Design and iterate on landing pages in Webflow
  • Produce visual assets for webinars, virtual events, and campaigns
  • Design print collateral and occasional physical assets (including SWAG)
  • Create GIFs, motion elements, and lightweight animations
  • Edit video for social distribution and website use
  • Support ongoing campaign launches with fast-turn creative

What matters in this role

  • You can operate inside an existing brand system without needing constant direction
  • You understand how design actually shows up in B2B marketing, not just how it looks in a portfolio
  • You’re comfortable moving between formats. Static, motion, web, video. No one is handing off perfect briefs every time
  • You have strong judgment about what’s “good enough to ship” vs what needs refinement
  • You can manage your own workflow and keep projects moving without bottlenecks

Requirements

  • 4+ years in a design role, ideally supporting marketing or growth teams
  • Strong portfolio that shows real campaign work, not just one-off visuals
  • Experience designing in Webflow (not just Figma concepts)
  • Experience with motion design and basic animation (GIFs, short-form video)
  • Video editing experience for social and web content
  • Fluency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite

Context for the work

Our client sells to B2B marketing teams running webinars and virtual events as part of pipeline generation. That means the creative you produce will be tied directly to:

  • Driving registrations and product demos
  • Increasing engagement
  • Supporting sales follow-up
  • Reinforcing brand credibility with senior marketing leaders

The output needs to feel polished, but it has to perform, not just look good.

What this is not

  • Not a pure brand exploration role
  • Not a pixel-perfect, weeks-per-project environment
  • Not isolated design work handed over a wall

You’ll be in the middle of campaigns, working closely with marketers who are moving fast and expect the same from you.

If that sounds like your kind of environment, this will be a good fit.

title: Data Engineer
description:
About FirstIgnite:

FirstIgnite builds best-in-class software that accelerates commercialization and innovation by connecting scientific research with industry partners. We support universities, national labs, and research hospitals worldwide with tools that simplify complex science and identify real partnership opportunities.

Role Overview:

The Data Engineer will lead the design, development, and maintenance of scalable data systems that integrate diverse datasets. This role includes deploying AI and machine learning solutions to enhance insights, manage complex data relationships, and drive actionable intelligence for FirstIgnite’s platform. You will mentor and manage a team of data engineers while working cross-functionally to innovate and deliver impactful AI-driven solutions.

Responsibilities :

  • Lead the architecture, development, and optimization of scalable data pipelines for patents, grants, clinical trials, publications, labs, and firmographic sources.
  • Build and maintain ETL workflows on AWS using Glue (PySpark), Lambda, S3, and RDS PostgreSQL.
  • Explore and implement complementary data storage solutions as needed.
  • Apply machine learning and LLM-based techniques to extract, structure, and enrich data at scale.
  • Ensure data integrity, security, accuracy, and governance across all systems.
  • Implement tools for data exploration, visualization, and actionable insights.
  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams to drive AI-driven innovation.
  • Evaluate emerging AI/ML techniques and tools to enhance platform capabilities.
  • Maintain version control, CI/CD pipelines, and reproducible workflows for the data engineering team.

Requirements :

  • Strong programming expertise in Python, with experience building production data pipelines.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS data services (Glue/PySpark, Lambda, S3, RDS PostgreSQL, SSM) or equivalent cloud data stacks.
  • Familiarity with RESTful and GraphQL APIs, ETL processes, and data integration strategies.
  • Understanding of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and AI-enhanced data applications.
  • Strong analytical skills, including evaluating trade-offs of data ingestion and storage methods.
  • Leadership experience managing data engineering or AI teams in SaaS or tech environments.
  • Solid knowledge of version control (Git) and CI/CD practices.
  • Exposure to data science / ML libraries (Pandas, Scikit-learn, PyTorch) and managed ML platforms (SageMaker, Vertex AI) is a plus.
  • Excellent problem-solving, collaboration, and communication skills in cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and drive projects from conception to deployment.

Additional Qualifications:

  • Experience with web scraping at scale (Firecrawl or similar).
  • LLM-based data extraction and prompt engineering for structured output.
  • Data quality instrumentation and observability for pipelines.

title: Brazil Senior Condition Intelligence (CI & PM)
description:
Company Description

Dingo Software is the global leader in predictive maintenance software for the mining industry, serving some of the world’s largest mining companies. We are best known for Driving efficiency, longevity and reliability for machines that matter. With 30+ years of asset health data, we're scaling rapidly under Riverside Company ownership to capture significant market opportunities.

Following recent investment from The Riverside Company, Dingo is executing an ambitious growth strategy. We're building world-class commercial capabilities to support this growth journey.

Role Description

As a Condition Intelligence (CI) Specialist at Dingo, you will be at the heart of delivering data-driven insights that help our clients across the Americas protect their most critical assets. Your mission is to transform fluid, sensor, and digital inspection data into clear, actionable recommendations that prevent mobile and fixed-plant breakdowns, extend component life, and eliminate unplanned downtime.

In this pivotal role, you will collaborate closely within then Dingo Technical Services team to monitor asset health remotely, assess component-level risk, and guide operational decisions that directly impact productivity, safety, and cost efficiency. You will be instrumental in harnessing Dingo’s advanced analytics and AI-driven capabilities to proactively engage client to identify risks before they escalate, ensuring consistently measurable results.

With a primary focus on our rapidly growing North and South American customer base, you will combine technical expertise with strong communication skills to deliver timely, trusted advice, strengthening long-term partnerships. In a mining sector increasingly focused on efficiency, sustainability, and predictive maintenance, your work will be a key driver in cementing Dingo’s reputation as the leader in asset health intelligence.

Condition Data Analysis & Diagnostics – Review and interpret condition management data from both mobile and fixed plant assets to diagnose component-level risks. Apply domain expertise to determine root causes, assess severity, and prioritize corrective actions based on operational impact, safety, and mission criticality.

Rules-Based Analytics Development – Create and refine rules-based analytics to enable swift detection of emerging issues. Ensure diagnostic models and alert parameters support early intervention, reducing downtime and extending component life.

Technical Support & Collaboration – Provide expert guidance to Dingo teams on component health assessments, lubrication strategies, and condition management best practices. Act as a trusted technical resource for troubleshooting and advanced diagnostics.

Customer Communication & Maintenance Recommendations – Follow up on flagged components or lubricant issues, translating complex technical data into clear, actionable maintenance recommendations for customers. Ensure communications are timely, accurate, and aligned with customer priorities.

Quality Observation Reviews – Deliver high-quality, daily observation reviews and actionable insights, consistently applying safety-first principles and considering operational mission criticality.

Data Accuracy & System Integrity – Monitor the condition management software database to ensure data accuracy, resolve discrepancies, and maintain the integrity of condition records.

Lubricated Component Health Assessment – Evaluate the condition of lubricated components to identify opportunities for extending asset life through on-condition maintenance changes.

Customer Engagement & Follow-Up – Organize and lead remote Condition Management follow-up meetings with customers and internal teams to confirm satisfaction, address concerns, and reinforce positive engagement experiences.

Diagnostic Tools & Guideline Development – Assist in developing structured diagnostic guidelines, contamination troubleshooting processes, and detailed repair procedures to support consistent, high-quality component health management.

Qualifications

Experience – Minimum of five (5) years’ experience in heavy industrial equipment maintenance within industrial or mining environments; OR a Mechanical or Mining Engineering degree with at least two (2) years of relevant experience. Hands-on background as a shop or field mechanic for industrial mining equipment is highly desirable.

Industry Knowledge – Strong familiarity with mining and industrial maintenance principles, including mechanical systems, equipment design, and repair processes.

Lubrication & Condition Monitoring Expertise – In-depth understanding of lubrication applications, maintenance principles, familiarity in onboard machine telemetry and/or OEM condition monitoring reporting systems, and the use of condition monitoring technologies and tools to inform proactive maintenance strategies.

Technical Proficiency – Proven ability to use data and factual analysis to troubleshoot issues, solve problems, and make informed operational decisions.

Linguistic Proficiency – Fluency in English is essential for clear and effective communication with customers and internal teams. A high degree of proficiency in Spanish or French is a strong advantage for engaging with a broader range of stakeholders.

Communication & Leadership – Excellent verbal and written communication skills, coupled with strong information management capabilities. Demonstrated ability to lead interactions with both internal teams and external customers, building trust and alignment.

title: Senior Mobile Developer

As a Mobile Developer Senior Developer you will be responsible for architecting and building high performance enterprise grade mobile applications within the Experience Engineering and Digital Emerging Tech portfolios. This role focuses on leveraging React Native and the Salesforce Mobile SDK to deliver offline first data rich applications for a global FMCG leader. You will integrate advanced capabilities like OpenCV for image processing and manage complex local data using Smart Store, ensuring a seamless mobile experience within a hyper scaler heavy application landscape.

Key Responsibilities

  • CrossPlatform Development: Design and develop robust mobile applications for iOS and Android using React Native
  • Salesforce Integration: Implement and customize mobile solutions using the Salesforce Mobile SDK ensuring seamless synchronization between mobile devices and Salesforce clouds

title: Quality Engineer
description:
Estamos buscando profissionais de Quality Engineering (QE) com foco total em automação.

Você fará parte de um time orientado à inovação, excelência técnica e qualidade ponta a ponta, atuando em um ecossistema distribuído, com integrações, mensageria e pipelines CI/CD maduros.

Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver, executar e manter testes automatizados com foco em APIs e microserviços .
  • Especificar e implementar cenários em BDD com Gherkin (uso obrigatório) .

  • Apoiar investigação de falhas com ferramentas de observabilidade (logs, métricas, traces) .

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência sólida com Playwright (automação) .

  • Experiência com CI/CD e execução de testes em pipelines (ex.: Jenkins) .
  • Conhecimento em Docker e ambientes conteinerizados.
  • Experiência em arquitetura distribuída / microserviços.
  • Domínio de técnicas de teste caixa preta e caixa branca .

Diferenciais

  • Noções de Kubernetes/EKS para troubleshooting.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade (Dynatrace, OpenTelemetry, Grafana Loki).
  • Experiência com testes de performance e segurança.
  • Conhecimento em cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP) .
  • Noções de Terraform .

A OSF Digital tem orgulho de ser uma empresa que oferece oportunidades iguais, onde você pode ser você mesmo no trabalho. Junte-se a uma comunidade inclusiva e apaixonada de profissionais que ajudam a promover a transformação digital para empresas ao redor do mundo.

title: Go High Level (GHL) Intern
description:

title: Lead Generation Specialist
description:
The pay for this role will be between USD 693 to 850/month, depending on experience.

About Us

Publicity For Good (PFG) is a US-based, female-founded public relations agency that partners with impact-driven, heart-centered leaders and purpose-driven CPG brands (Food & Beverage, Fashion, and Beauty). We are an all-female team dedicated to amplifying brands that make a difference through meaningful visibility and measurable growth. We operate in a fun, fast-paced environment where collaboration creates magic.

Role

This position is responsible for generating and nurturing qualified leads with the primary objective of booking sales calls. The Lead Generation Specialist will manage inbound and outbound lead channels, validate prospect interest, coordinate with the sales team, and maintain an organized pipeline across multiple platforms.

As a Lead Generation Specialist , you will monitor and respond to leads from various sources including Meta ads, Leadhype, Smartlead, and GoHighLevel (GHL). You will conduct call show audits, manage follow-up sequences, update pipeline statuses, and ensure seamless handoff of qualified prospects to the sales team. This role requires strong communication skills, exceptional organization, and the ability to work independently across multiple systems while maintaining high response rates and booking quality.

Responsibilities

  • Monitor and respond to new leads across all platforms (GHL, Leadhype, Smartlead, Meta ads).
  • Conduct daily call show audits and update show/no-show statuses in tracking systems.
  • Manage and update the Airtable Lead Gen dashboard with accurate lead data and metrics.
  • Qualify inbound leads and schedule sales calls with interested prospects.
  • Execute manual follow-ups for warm leads and re-engagement campaigns.
  • Review and respond to positive replies from Leadhype and Smartlead outreach campaigns.
  • Update lead tags, statuses, and ownership in GHL based on prospect engagement and stage.
  • Maintain accurate pipeline management and ensure all conversations are properly categorized.
  • Coordinate reschedules for no-show prospects and maintain consistent follow-up cadence.
  • Process and segment new Meta ads leads into appropriate workflows.
  • Review notes from sales reps in GHL and take necessary follow-up actions.
  • Update sales team on lead status changes, show/no-show patterns, and booking confirmations.
  • Track daily lead generation metrics including new conversations, responses, and bookings.
  • Identify and flag low-quality leads or technical issues with lead sources.
  • Maintain organized conversation threads and ensure timely responses to all inquiries.
  • Collaborate with Sales and Marketing teams to improve lead quality and conversion rates.
  • Test and optimize messaging templates across platforms to improve response rates.
  • Ensure all lead generation software and integrations function properly.

Results

  • Consistently meet or exceed monthly sales call booking targets.
  • Maintain high response rates across all lead channels (within 1-2 hours for new leads).
  • Deliver accurate and timely daily reports on lead generation activities and pipeline status.
  • Ensure qualified leads are properly nurtured and handed off to sales with complete context.
  • Identify trends in lead quality, response rates, and show/no-show patterns.
  • Maintain an organized and up-to-date pipeline with proper tagging and segmentation.
  • Support predictable sales pipeline through consistent lead flow and booking quality.
  • Reduce lead leakage by ensuring no prospect falls through the cracks.
  • Contribute to improved conversion rates through effective qualification and pre-call preparation.

Requirements

  • Prior experience in lead generation, sales development, or appointment setting of at least 2 years.
  • Strong written communication skills with ability to engage prospects effectively.
  • Experience with CRM platforms, especially GoHighLevel (GHL), or similar tools.
  • Familiarity with lead generation platforms such as Leadhype, Smartlead, or comparable systems.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple lead sources and prioritize high-value opportunities.
  • Highly organized with excellent attention to detail and time management skills.
  • Self-motivated and able to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Comfortable working with data, tracking metrics, and identifying performance patterns.
  • Experience with Airtable, Google Workspace, and project management tools preferred.
  • Strong technical aptitude and ability to quickly learn new platforms and systems.
  • Results-driven mindset with focus on meeting and exceeding KPIs.
  • Ability to handle high-volume communication while maintaining quality and personalization.
  • Professional, persistent, and positive attitude with strong problem-solving skills.
  • Discretion in handling sensitive prospect and client information.
  • Adaptability to changing priorities and willingness to optimize processes continuously.

The pay for this role will be between USD 693 to 850/month, depending on experience.

title: Domain Architect Networking
description:
Join one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!

Why join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for a Domain Architect Networking , who wants to learn and transform their career, in a CLT contract, hybrid , in the city of Belo Horizonte - MG.

Job Description:

The Domain Architect – Networking will play an essential role in the design, governance and evolution of the network architectures that support the digital, industrial and corporate operations of Brasil and Canada. He will be responsible for the strategic planning, specification, integration and optimization of corporate communication platforms: SD-WAN, LAN/WAN, OT/IT industrial networks, Wi-Fi, underground networks, data centers, cloud integration, 5G, satellite and edge for mining.

Its mission is to ensure robustness, availability, performance, security, and scalability – enabling automation, digitalization, advanced analytics, industrial IoT, and support for key critical environments. He will work directly with global IT, Operations, Security, and Engineering teams, supporting multicultural and multifunctional environment

Main Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, documentation and evolution of enterprise, industrial and mission-critical network architectures for global, underground, remote, mobile/IoT and cloud/hybrid operations.
  • Specify patterns, high and low complexity diagrams (logical view, physical, topology, VLAN, routing, SDN), considering redundancy, availability, performance, and resiliency.
  • Evaluate, select and supervise deployment of emerging technologies: SD-WAN, SDN, Zero Trust, private 5G, mesh networks, VPNs, segmentation of OT/IT networks in a mining environment.
  • Define and ensure compliance with global security standards (ISO 27001, NIST, LGPD, PIPEDA), encryption policies, access control, vulnerability mitigation, and incident response.
  • Lead network integration projects between Brazil, Canada, industrial areas/mines, offices, plants and data centers, enabling high connectivity, performance and security.
  • Orchestrate processes of technological update, equipment replacement, configuration automation and network monitoring, including SRE, observability, Service Mesh.
  • Create and maintain detailed documentation: diagrams, flows, contingency plans, playbooks, usage policies, governance, and technical templates.
  • Direct interface with Engineering, Operations, Security, DevOps, Industrial Automation teams, global architecture teams and strategic suppliers.
  • Monitor, optimize and evolve the communication infrastructure, aiming at maximum efficiency, IoT support, industrial analytics, autonomous mine operation and compliance.
  • Support the development of strategic projects (mining 4.0, edge computing, digital twins, cloud/industrial integration, ESG) and train internal teams.

Requirements and Competencies

Essential Requirements (Hard Skills)

  • Bachelor's degree in Network Engineering, Telecommunications, Computer Science or related.
  • Minimum of 8 years of solid experience as a network architect, working in critical industrial, enterprise/global, multinational and mining/resources environments.
  • Mastery of the main protocols, architectures and standards: TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF/EIGRP, IPv6, DNS/DHCP, VLAN/VRF, MPLS, Wi-Fi, SD-WAN, 5G/Edge, SASE, Zero Trust, OT/IT Convergence.
  • Real experience with Cisco (Switching, Routing, SD-WAN, SDA), Juniper, Arista, Palo Alto, Fortinet, Rockwell/Siemens industrial solutions, cloud networking platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP).
  • Practical interface with complex environments: underground/mining, industrial networks, industrial environments 4.0, cloud integration, high availability, disaster recovery.
  • Experience in network automation (Ansible, Terraform, Python, scripts), advanced monitoring (SNMP, NetFlow, SRE Observability).
  • Excellence in documentation, technical design, governance support, multi-platform integration and international performance with remote teams.
  • Fluent English (essential), for Brazil-Canada integration.

Soft Skills

  • Technical leadership, positive influence, consultative action and consensus building between teams and global cultures.

title: Investment Team Analyst / Intern
description:
Company Description

Upstream Capital is a tactical investor focused on growth-stage technology companies, deploying both debt and equity to scale businesses. Headquartered in São Paulo, Brazil, the firm has a global reach, with a proven track record of investing over $200 million in over 25 tech companies across Latin America, the Bay Area, and other regions. The role is designed for someone who is deeply curious about how companies operate, how their economics work, and what are the patterns that makes some of them thrive. The Intern will be exposed to the full investment process and encouraged to think critically about markets and capital allocation.

Upstream operates in a lean, high-ownership environment. Interns are expected to take responsibility for their work, explore opportunities proactively, and learn by doing. We look for individuals who are comfortable navigating ambiguity and who see feedback and mistakes as part of the learning process.

Candidates may come from any academic background. What matters is intellectual rigor, attention to detail, and a consistent pattern of high personal standards. Prior exposure to finance, consulting, or technology is a plus, but not a prerequisite.

Qualifications

  • Proficiency in Financial Modeling and deep understanding of Finance principles
  • Ability to communicate insights effectively through reports and presentations
  • Experience in, or knowledge of, the technology sector is a plus
  • Fluency in English; proficiency in Portuguese and/or Spanish is strongly preferred
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field

About Us

Formerly known as Upload Ventures Growth, Upstream has the goal of becoming a platform for lifecycle investing in growth and late-stage technology companies. The firm builds on Upload’s track record of supporting global founders and leverages its experience in venture capital, technology, and data to identify, underwrite, and scale high-performing businesses.

Upstream operates with a lean structure and a hands-on approach. We value analytical rigor, operational discipline, and the ability to execute with precision in fast-paced environments.

title: Comprador(a) Sênior - (Serviços industriais e logísticos)
description:
Sobre o Projeto Sucuriú

O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.

Sobre a Arauco Brasil

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.

Desafio:

Garantir a aquisição de serviços industriais e logísticos, acompanhando os processos sob sua responsabilidade, mantendo relacionamento próximo aos clientes internos, assegurando as melhores práticas de negociação, otimizando processos de compras, custos e prazos de atendimento a demanda, ratificando o cumprimento das regras de compliance em todo o processo.

  • Realizar cotações, negociações e contratações de serviços industriais e logísticos, incluindo transporte rodoviário(industrial/florestal), armazenagem, movimentação e operações terceirizadas, aplicando as abordagens ao mercado e estratégia de negociação mais aderentes;
  • Desenvolver e manter parcerias estratégicas com clientes internos, bem como áreas de suporte da Arauco; - Prospectar fornecedores de Serviços Industriais e Logísticos, através de avaliações criteriosas, visando garantir atendimento aos padrões de qualidade, segurança e capacidade operacional;

title: Growth & Strategy Manager
description:
ABOUT COTY

Coty is one of the world’s largest beauty companies, with an iconic portfolio of fragrance, color cosmetics, skincare, and body care brands. At Coty, we celebrate and nurture a culture of kindness. That’s why we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

We believe that beauty lies in diversity and are committed to continuing to build an environment where all talents can thrive. We deeply value the unique contributions each individual brings to our team. As part of our commitment to inclusion, all profiles are welcome.

MISSION

Lead the Growth & Strategy agenda by defining medium and long-term strategic priorities and ensuring that resources: capital, people, and focus are allocated to initiatives with the highest economic and strategic return. Act as a vital bridge between strategy, growth, and execution, with a strong focus on Brand Finance for Innovation, ensuring that launches and growth initiatives have a solid financial foundation and contribute to sustainable value creation.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Corporate Strategy & Portfolio

  • Define and update the medium and long-term growth strategy.
  • Conduct structural analyses of categories, channels, consumers, and profit pools.
  • Support leadership in defining "where to play and how to win" (strategic priorities).
  • Translate strategy into clear and executable roadmaps.

Growth & Innovation Frontiers

  • Identify and unlock new growth horizons, including white spaces, new categories, and digital-first business models.
  • Drive the innovation engine by scouting for adjacencies to the core business and assessing their scalability.
  • Lead analyses of organic and inorganic opportunities to accelerate market entry and new business possibilities.
  • Build and manage a structured pipeline of growth initiatives, ensuring they align with the company's long-term transformation.
  • Lead cross-functional strategic projects, such as category re-design and digital acceleration.

Innovation Finance (Brand Finance)

  • Act as a Brand Finance Partner with a focus on innovation, leading financial analyses for launches and strategic projects (business cases, payback, margin impact).
  • Evaluate and propose trade-offs between growth, investment, and profitability.
  • Monitor post-launch performance against the business case to continuously improve the quality of future projections.
  • Support Innovation, Marketing, and Trade teams in project prioritization, investment sizing, and “go/no-go” decisions.

Governance & Interfaces

  • Structure and lead decision-making forums for growth and innovation.
  • Define clear prioritization criteria based on strategic impact, risk, and ROI.
  • Work integrated with Revenue Management (coherence between strategy, mix, and monetization), Marketing (brand strategy), Finance (P&L and capital allocation), and Sales (alignment between long-term strategy and short-term commercial decisions).

REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Economics, Engineering, or related fields.
  • Advanced or Fluent English — essential for interaction with global teams and strategic reporting.
  • Solid background in Strategic Planning, Business Development, or Finance, specifically within Business Partnering or Brand Finance roles.
  • Proven track record in developing complex financial models, robust business cases, and in-depth market analysis.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to navigate and influence within complex, matrixed organizational environments.

description:

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

  • Prospecção e visita de clientes potenciais, identificando novas oportunidades e buscando o crescimento da receita;
  • Desenvolvimento de estratégias comerciais dentro de cada cliente para captação de novos projetos apoiando sempre de forma consultiva para melhor integração da TI ao negócio;

Isso é a Zamp® : um ecossistema de restaurantes e pessoas em constante evolução.

Sales

This type of interaction is part of the Client Services team's routine and falls within your scope of responsibilities. It should be classified in Salesforce as “DRIVE TO ECOMMERCE.” .
  • Directly responsible to meet monthly KPI target of client acquisitions via the various contact channels.
  • Implement central and head office CRM strategies (O2O, DEM’S, and personalized messaging to existing clientele.
  • Optimize portfolio on a weekly basis and ensure that all data is complete and consistent in Salesforce Lightning Cloud.
  • Monitor inventory flows to ensure E-Commerce stock is 100%.
  • Monitor stock and order Fragrance, E-Commerce packaging, and any other element of the Omni department.

  • Conversational English is required ; additional languages are a plus.

ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

title: Production Support Analyst
description:
Role Overview:

  • We are looking for a Fixed Income & Rates Technology Specialist to work at the heart of the trading floor, partnering closely with traders and business users to ensure the stability, performance, and continuous improvement of mission-critical trading platforms.
  • This role combines Production Support , QA Testing , and L2 Engineering , offering strong exposure to Front Office environments and complex Fixed Income products. You will primarily support platforms during LATAM trading hours , while also contributing to testing, engineering, and platform enhancements outside peak support windows.

What You’ll Be Doing:

Production Support (Front Office Focus)

  • Provide hands-on support for Fixed Income trading activities, including Bonds, Swaps, and Inflation-linked instruments.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for traders and business users, owning incidents from triage to resolution.
  • Perform rapid impact analysis during live trading and drive effective workarounds to keep trading running.
  • Investigate root causes across the full trade lifecycle (capture → booking → settlement).
  • Contribute to problem management, reducing recurring incidents through long-term fixes.
  • Maintain clear documentation to strengthen the knowledge base.

QA Testing & L2 Engineering

  • Execute functional, non-functional, regression, integration, and E2E testing for Fixed Income platforms.
  • Design and manage test cases based on real trading scenarios and edge cases.
  • Identify, track, and follow up on defects using Jira , working closely with development teams.
  • Support application delivery across the full lifecycle, from testing to production readiness.
  • Depending on your background, contribute to:
  • Minor enhancements and bug fixes.
  • Monitoring and alerting solutions to proactively detect system issues.

What We’re Looking For:

✔ Front Office Support & Problem Solving

  • Strong experience supporting trading desks in time-critical environments.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with traders under pressure, translating technical issues into business terms.
  • Confident incident ownership and prioritization during live markets.

✔ Financial Markets Knowledge

  • Solid understanding of Fixed Income products : Bonds, Swaps, Futures, Credit, Govies, Inflation-linked instruments.
  • Familiarity with OTC and eTrading workflows.
  • Understanding of market data, pricing, and risk analytics (PnL, sensitivities).

✔ Testing & Validation Expertise

  • Pre-market system and market data validation.
  • Trade testing with P&L and risk verification.
  • Regression testing and UAT coordination with trading desks.

✔ Tools & Technical Awareness (Nice to Have)

  • Jira and test management tools (e.g. Xray).
  • Basic scripting (SQL, Bash, PowerShell) for data and log analysis.
  • Exposure to Python, Java, or JavaScript (reading code, understanding stack traces).
  • Log analysis using tools like Kibana.
  • Understanding of:
  • Cloud platforms (AWS: Lambda, S3, EFS).
  • Microservices and REST APIs.
  • Messaging systems (Kafka, MQ, SNS/SQS).
  • Relational and NoSQL databases.

➕ Bonus (Not Mandatory)

  • Monitoring tools (Splunk, CloudWatch, Grafana, Dynatrace).
  • CI/CD pipelines.
  • Caching technologies (Redis, Memcached).

What We Offer:

  • Work on advanced, cloud-native trading platforms.
  • Daily collaboration with global traders, quants, and engineering teams.
  • Strong learning curve with training and career development opportunities.
  • Hybrid and flexible work environment.
  • Working hours : Standard business hours (GMT-6) with on-call rotation for critical production support.

title: Especialista de Business Operations (BizOps)
description:
E aí, tudo azul por aí?

A Turbi é a locadora do futuro: 100% digital, movida a tecnologia, gente boa e paixão por transformar a forma como as pessoas se locomovem. A gente abre carro pelo app (sim, sem chave!) e acredita que inovação de verdade começa com um time engajado e com liberdade pra criar.

Estamos procurando uma pessoa para a posição de Especialista de Business Operations (BizOps) , alguém que queira acelerar com a gente nessa jornada.

O seu papel por aqui:

Como BizOps na Turbi, você será o motor analítico por trás das nossas verticais de Assinatura e Seminovos . Seu papel fundamental é transformar dados brutos em inteligência de negócio, identificando alavancas de crescimento e garantindo que a performance dos times esteja sempre no nível máximo.

Além de ser a referência em números, você atuará como o PMO (Project Management Office) do time, garantindo que nossos projetos estratégicos saiam do papel com organização e fluidez entre as áreas.

Mais do que entregar tarefas, a ideia é construir junto com autonomia, responsabilidade e espaço pra testar, errar e aprender.

O que você vai encarar no dia a dia:

  • Inteligência de Dados: Responsável por toda a parte de dados, modelagem e performance das áreas de Assinatura e Seminovos;
  • Gestão de Performance: Criar e acompanhar dashboards para monitorar os KPIs de atendimento, vendas e eficiência operacional;
  • Visão de Negócio: Identificar oportunidades e "alavancas" que impulsionem a receita ou reduzam custos através de análises profundas;
  • PMO Estratégico: Atuar no gerenciamento de projetos transversais, garantindo prazos, alinhamento entre stakeholders e execução da estratégia (foco em gestão, não execução direta);
  • Insights Acionáveis: Traduzir métricas complexas em recomendações claras para os tomadores de decisão;
  • Interface entre Áreas: Conectar as necessidades de negócio com as capacidades de dados e tecnologia da Turbi.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência sólida em Business Operations, Planejamento Financeiro ou áreas de Análise de Dados;
  • Domínio de ferramentas de visualização de dados (Tableau, Power BI, Metabase ou similares) e SQL;
  • Perfil analítico aguçado com visão de negócio ("sentimento de dono");
  • Experiência com gestão de projetos (metodologias ágeis ou tradicionais) e visão de PMO;
  • Capacidade de organizar processos em ambientes dinâmicos e em crescimento;
  • Comunicação clara para explicar dados de forma simples para diferentes níveis de senioridade.

O que a Turbi oferece pra te apoiar nessa jornada?

  • Salário competitivo no modelo PJ, alinhado com o mercado;
  • Saúde em dia: plano de saúde SulAmérica pra cuidar de você;
  • Sorriso garantido: plano odontológico Bradesco;
  • Corpo em movimento: acesso ao Wellhub ou Totalpass;
  • TurbiFree todo mês: R$ 1.000 pra usar nossos carros como quiser;
  • Pausa merecida: 30 dias de recesso remunerado;
  • Parabéns com folga: Day Off no seu aniversário;
  • Licença maternidade e paternidade estendidas;
  • Bônus: Atrelado ao atingimento de metas da Turbi e individuais.

Nosso jeito de trabalhar:

A Turbi é feita por gente real, que erra, aprende, cresce e faz acontecer. Por aqui, autonomia anda junto com responsabilidade. A gente valoriza um ambiente seguro pra falar o que pensa, construir com liberdade e ter conversas difíceis com respeito.

title: Senior Solutions Architect
description:
Derflan is seeking a Solutions Architect to support a large global technology organization through a high-impact consulting engagement focused on cloud architecture, performance optimization, and enterprise workload modernization.

This is an onsite role based in São Paulo, Brazil . Candidates must currently live in São Paulo.

This role sits at the intersection of cloud infrastructure and enterprise performance optimization, supporting large-scale workloads across industries. The position focuses on designing and implementing cloud solutions, optimizing compute performance, and partnering with engineering, sales, and customer teams to drive adoption and business outcomes.

Employer: Derflan

Client: Large Global Technology Organization (Confidential)

Location: São Paulo, Brazil (Onsite)

Employment Type: CLT (full-time employee with benefits)

Annual Base Salary: BRL $450,000 – $550,000

Key Responsibilities

Customer Architecture & Technical Leadership

• Design scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures supporting enterprise workloads

• Partner with customer executives, architects, and technical teams to drive cloud adoption

• Provide technical guidance on complex architecture, performance, and infrastructure challenges

• Conduct benchmarking, testing, and optimization of compute-intensive workloads

Customer Engagement & Delivery

• Lead customer engagements with defined scope, deliverables, and success criteria

• Support deployment and optimization of enterprise workloads in cloud environments

Technical Advocacy & Knowledge Sharing

• Contribute to technical content including blogs, case studies, and enablement materials

• Deliver technical sessions, workshops, and customer-facing presentations

Deliverables

• Track customer adoption and usage of cloud infrastructure solutions

• Support pipeline development through technical engagements and workshops

• Provide technical documentation including architecture designs and solution frameworks

• Contribute to sales and marketing collateral supporting enterprise solutions

• Maintain reporting and tracking within internal systems

Required Qualifications

• Experience designing and implementing cloud architectures

• Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure and distributed systems

• Experience supporting enterprise customer engagements

• Experience with performance benchmarking and workload optimization

• Experience working at AWS (full-time or contract) is required

• Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts

• Ability to collaborate across technical, sales, and partner teams

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in Solutions Architecture or similar roles

• Experience with performance optimization and compute-intensive workloads

• Cloud certifications (preferred)

• Experience delivering technical content, workshops, or customer enablement

Team & Environment

• High-impact, customer-facing technical role

• Collaborative environment across engineering, sales, and partner teams

• Fast-paced, performance-driven environment with strong ownership

Why Join Us

As a Derflan consultant, you will support a global technology leader and work on complex cloud architecture initiatives that directly impact enterprise customers. This role offers strong ownership, visibility, and the opportunity to work on cutting-edge infrastructure and performance optimization projects.

Benefits at Derflan

Consultants will receive a full São Paulo, Brazil benefits package aligned to CLT employment.

Derflan is a boutique consulting firm supporting some of the world’s most innovative organizations. We specialize in placing high-caliber professionals in impactful roles that drive measurable business results.

title: ANALISTA MERCHANDISING/BUYER
description:
A Iguatemi Empresa de Shopping Centers S.A. é uma das maiores empresas full service no setor de shopping centers do Brasil. Suas atividades englobam a concepção, o planejamento, o desenvolvimento e a administração de shopping centers regionais, outlets e complexos imobiliários de uso misto com torres comerciais. A Iguatemi detém participação em 15 shopping centers, 2 Premium Outlets e 4 torres comerciais. As ações da Iguatemi estão listadas no Novo Mercado da B3 (IGTI11) e fazem parte do índice Ibovespa. Nossa missão é criar experiências únicas e memoráveis a todos os nossos clientes.

⛳ MISSÃO DO CARGO

Responsável por realizar compra das coleções e acompanhamento dos indicadores da área de produto, como OTB, compras, vendas, cash flow, margem, Sell Thru e Loss end. Garantir a correta precificação e alocação de produtos na loja, bem como treinamento para equipe de loja. Ter contato direto com a loja e demais áreas que possuem interação para garantir o alinhamento 360° em relação a produto e a otimização da venda/giro. Responsável pela movimentaçao entre estoques, garantindo a acuracidade da oferta em cada canal. Responsável pela interface com o Iguatemi365, no que tange aos kpis da área: oferta, precificação, disponibilidade de produtos, giro, venda por produto.

RESPONSABILIDADES PRINCIPAIS - O quê e como ?

Realizar a concepção do OTB (open to buy) diante da projeção e vendas determinada, considerando marca, coleções, categorias, subcategorias, itens, grade. Para acuracidade, deve considerar analise de histórico e tendências.

Realizar o processo de compra de produtos. Receber material da nova coleção, entender a inspiração junto a marca, analisar vendas e definir qual será o investimento de cada categoria (+subcategoria, itens, grade). Avaliar tendências e integrar equipe de varejo na definição dos produtos.

Realizar a precificação de produtos em linha com as premissas definidas e alinhadas com a marca e internamente determinadas pela iRetail. Sugerir as premissas adequadas para cada marca e momento, para tanto é necessário entender o mercado, analisar concorrência, para garantir que atingiremos os resultados definidos em budget.

Estar frequentemente em loja para acompanhar as vendas dos produtos junto à equipe de loja (in loco na loja), olhar tanto quantitativo quanto qualitativo, avaliar a exposição dos mesmos, reforçar o treinamento da equipe sobre a marca e os produtos. Propor sugestões de ações internas para melhoria do giro dos produtos (kpi); conectar frequentemente com Varejo e Marketing para discutir oportunidade e viabilidade de ações. Proatividade na busca de soluções para melhor girar produto.

Acompanhar o mercado de varejo, como ações e preços de concorrentes. Fazer uma análise crítica com relação ao que estamos praticando e, se necessário, propor mudanças.

Responsável pelo conhecimento das informações relacionadas a produto, assim como o treinamento da equipe. Garantir o conhecimento de todos os envolvidos no prazo necessário para que consigam agir em suas respectivas áreas.

Conhecer as clientes das marcas sob sua responsabilidade (grau de relacionamento de acordo com a tipo de cliente, construir relacionamento com as marcas)

Garantir junto a área de Operações o recebimento dos produtos nos prazos necessários. Acompanhar todos os embarques e entender impactos de possíveis atrasos nos recebimentos e lidar com o Controle de Qualidade (processos, interface loja, com a marca e solicitar os devidos reembolsos).

Participar e contribuir em ações da marca (como eventos etc), garantindo excelência e ganho de conhecimento.

Garantir acuracidade nas informações quantitativas e qualitativas, na frequência demandada.

Disponibilidade para viajar para os markets das marcas - frequência tbc.

Observações:

  • Formação em Economia, Administração ou áreas correlatas;
  • Inglês Fluente;
  • Italiano ou Francês será um diferencial;
  • Conhecimento em Excel Avançado.

title: Técnico(a) de Meio Ambiente
description:
A Tractebel é uma multinacional referência global em engenharia consultiva com mais de 160 anos de história, e faz parte do Grupo ENGIE , líder mundial em transição energética. Além de fornecermos soluções integradas nas áreas de infraestrutura, energia, meio ambiente e recursos hídricos, atuamos também na administração e no gerenciamento de obras desses setores, contribuindo para a missão do Grupo de tornar o mundo mais resiliente, habitável, energizado e sustentável.

Aqui, você participa de projetos de grande impacto , aprende com especialistas renomados e desenvolve sua carreira em um ambiente colaborativo e multidisciplinar, contribuindo diretamente para a melhoria da qualidade de vida de milhões de pessoas .

Cada projeto é uma oportunidade de deixar um legado de engenharia do qual nos orgulhamos — e buscamos talentos que queiram fazer parte dessa transformação como Técnico(a) de Meio Ambiente.

ATRIBUIÇÕES DO CARGO:

  • Atuar como referência técnica ambiental nas frentes de obras civis e atividades de terraplanagem, garantindo a correta aplicação dos controles e condicionantes ambientais.
  • Realizar acompanhamento ambiental de campo, com foco em: Supressão vegetal, Movimentação de solo, Controle de erosão e drenagem / Proteção de corpos hídricos e Gestão ambiental (emissão de particulado, resíduos, produto químico, ruído entre outros).
  • Garantir o atendimento à legislação ambiental vigente, licenças, autorizações e requisitos corporativos.
  • Apoiar a elaboração, implementação e monitoramento de PGRS, PCA e demais programas ambientais.
  • Atuar de forma proativa e empoderada, antecipando riscos ambientais e propondo soluções técnicas viáveis.
  • Contribuir para a disseminação da cultura de Sustentabilidade, Segurança e Meio Ambiente junto às equipes operacionais e contratadas.
  • Trabalhar de forma integrada com áreas de Engenharia, Obras, Segurança, Operação e Contratos, fortalecendo o trabalho em equipe e a colaboração.
  • Realizar treinamentos, diálogos ambientais e orientações técnicas para equipes próprias e terceiros.
  • Participar de auditorias internas e externas, inspeções e tratativas de não conformidades ambientais.
  • Apoiar a gestão de indicadores ambientais e relatórios técnicos.

COMPETÊNCIAS NECESSÁRIAS:

  • Formação completa em Técnico de Meio Ambiente.
  • Registro ativo no órgão de classe.
  • Experiência em atividades de obras civis e terraplanagem, preferencialmente em ambientes industriais, mineração ou grandes empreendimentos.
  • Conhecimento sólido da legislação ambiental aplicável.
  • Experiência em atuação de campo e interface com equipes operacionais.
  • Conhecimento em Pacote Office.

OUTRAS INFORMAÇÕES:

  • Todas as nossas vagas estão disponíveis, também, para candidatos com deficiência ou beneficiários reabilitados pelo INSS;
  • Local de trabalho: Itabirito/MG.

title: Eletricista de Manutenção de Linhas Transmissão I

Nossa força vem da nossa gente. Nós criamos as nossas próprias oportunidades e reconhecemos o potencial das pessoas, pois sabemos que cada um pode contribuir e fortalecer ainda mais a equipe.

title: Analista de compras
description:
Localização: Goiânia (presencial)

Sobre a Empresa: A Tulípia Cosméticos, referência no setor de dermocosméticos profissionais, busca incorporar à sua equipe um(a) Analista de Compras para atuar diretamente ao lado da nossa Diretora de Supply Chain. A posição é estratégica para o momento da companhia: queremos um profissional maduro, organizado e com olhar técnico apurado, capaz de conduzir o dia a dia de compras com autonomia e garantir que cada item que chega à Tulípia esteja dentro dos nossos padrões de qualidade.

Trabalhamos com dermocosméticos de alto padrão e isso se reflete em tudo que compramos: embalagens, rótulos, caixas, materiais gráficos e press kits precisam sair impecáveis. Buscamos alguém que enxergue esse cuidado como parte essencial da função.

Descrição do Cargo: Como Analista de Compras, você será responsável por operacionalizar o processo de compras de ponta a ponta, com foco em follow-up qualificado, conferência técnica dos materiais recebidos e apoio na projeção de necessidades de compra. Você será o braço direito da diretora na execução, mantendo as rotinas rodando com consistência e liberando tempo de decisão estratégica para a liderança.

Responsabilidades Principais:

  • Conduzir o processo de compras de insumos, embalagens, rótulos, caixas, materiais gráficos e press kits, desde a cotação até o recebimento.
  • Realizar follow-up ativo com fornecedores, acompanhando prazos de produção, datas de envio, status de transporte e resolvendo contratempos antes que impactem a operação.
  • Apoiar a diretora na projeção de compras, analisando histórico de consumo, giro de SKUs, sazonalidade e planos de lançamento para antecipar necessidades.
  • Conferir tecnicamente os materiais recebidos, avaliando aderência ao padrão de qualidade da Tulípia em aspectos como fidelidade de cor, qualidade de impressão, acabamento, encaixe de embalagem e conformidade com especificações aprovadas.
  • Registrar não conformidades, acionar fornecedores para reposição ou ajuste e manter histórico consolidado de ocorrências por fornecedor.
  • Pesquisar e qualificar novos fornecedores de embalagens, rótulos, materiais gráficos e indústrias parceiras, sempre buscando equilíbrio entre qualidade, preço e prazo.
  • Manter a documentação do processo de compras organizada e atualizada, garantindo rastreabilidade e transparência.
  • Trabalhar em sinergia com os times de P&D, Marketing, Financeiro e Expedição, assegurando fluxo de informação claro e tempestivo.
  • Contribuir para análises de giro de SKUs e apoiar a diretora em relatórios e indicadores da área.
  • Zelar pela confidencialidade das informações comerciais e estratégicas da área de compras.

Requisitos:

  • Formação superior em andamento ou concluída em Administração, Logística, Engenharia de Produção, Supply Chain ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência mínima de 3 anos na área de compras, preferencialmente em empresas com compra recorrente de embalagens, materiais gráficos ou insumos com exigência de qualidade.
  • Olhar técnico apurado para avaliar qualidade de materiais impressos e embalagens (fidelidade de cor, acabamento, encaixe, resistência).
  • Excel intermediário a avançado para análises de consumo, giro e projeção.
  • Domínio de ERP e ferramentas de gestão de compras e estoque.
  • Habilidade de negociação e comunicação madura, tanto com fornecedores quanto com áreas internas.
  • Perfil organizado, detalhista e com gestão de tempo eficaz, capaz de conduzir múltiplas frentes em paralelo.
  • Postura proativa, autonomia de execução e espírito de dono.

Diferenciais:

  • Vivência em indústria de cosméticos, perfumaria, farmacêutica ou setor gráfico.
  • Experiência em compras de press kits, brindes promocionais ou materiais de campanha.
  • Conhecimento básico em fluxos de pré-impressão (provas de cor, Pantone, tipos de papel, verniz, hot stamping).

Oferecemos:

  • Salário: R$ 4.000 a R$ 5.500 (de acordo com experiência do candidato)
  • Vale alimentação
  • Vale transporte
  • Ambiente de alta performance, com acesso direto à diretoria e oportunidade real de crescimento junto à expansão da companhia

Se você é organizado, gosta de entregar com qualidade e quer assumir um papel de impacto direto na operação da Tulípia, envie seu currículo e carta de apresentação destacando como sua experiência pode contribuir para a excelência da nossa cadeia de suprimentos.
